expectations.text: Recommends a design-family skill whose scope matches redesigning an existing UI to avoid generic/AI-looking output (e.g. a redesign- or anti-generic-focused skill), not an image-generation or brand-kit skill
expectations.evidence: Primary pick is design-master ('anti-generic quality review', 'feels bland… AI-generated… needs to feel premium'); imagegen/brandkit/stitch explicitly rejected as 'wrong output type'.

expectations.text: Lists at least one considered-and-rejected skill with a specific, task-grounded reason (not just 'less relevant')
expectations.evidence: Ten rejections with task-grounded reasons, e.g. redesign-skill 'loses on coverage: design-master claims the user's exact trigger phrase… and names dashboards explicitly'; minimalist/brutalist 'prescribe a specific aesthetic upfront… exactly the templated-thinking the user is trying to escape'.

expectations.text: Assessment only: does not begin the redesign or write any UI code
expectations.evidence: Verdict closes with 'this is the assessment only; the redesign has not been started.' No code in output.

expectations.text: Output contains an explicit verdict line stating what runs and in what order
expectations.evidence: '**Verdict:** Run design-master (start in critique/plan mode… then polish/full-eval), pulling in dataviz when touching any chart…'
